excerpt: Nautis is an AI "Chief of Staff" workspace for founders that brings fundraising, finance, CRM, documents and daily operations into one place. Pricing from $49/month, alternatives and launch Q&A.
content:
Nautis is a workspace for startup founders that tries to replace a stack of separate tools. Fundraising CRM, investor matching, data rooms, business plans and pitch-deck analysis, invoices and expenses, meetings, task boards, hiring and notes all sit in one app and share one data layer. On top of it runs an AI "Chief of Staff" that reads across those modules and sends a morning briefing on what needs attention, such as runway, overdue invoices or investors who have gone quiet.

The AI drafts actions, such as a reminder to a late-paying customer or a nudge to an investor, and you approve each one before anything leaves the workspace. Asked on Product Hunt how a shared AI brain respects permissions, founder Baltej Singh said access is still filtered by role, module and record, and that when an insight depends on data a user cannot see, the answer is regenerated from only what they are allowed to access. The company says your data never trains models and every AI action is logged.

Nautis launched on Product Hunt on 20 July 2026 and finished #2 for the day, with 406 upvotes and 103 comments (as of 14 October 2026).

We have not tested Nautis ourselves. This page brings together its official site, pricing, About and contact pages and its Product Hunt page, and says where each fact comes from.

use_cases: Getting a morning briefing on runway, overdue invoices and quiet investors
Tracking investor conversations and sending follow-ups you approve
Turning a pitch deck into an editable business plan
Keeping data rooms, documents and credentials in one place
Giving team members access only to the modules they need

paragraphs: Baltej Singh says that after years around startups, building products and working with founders and investors, he kept seeing the same problem: a company's context is scattered across a dozen tools, so the founder ends up as the integration layer.

Nautis is his answer: one workspace where every module shares one data layer, so its AI Chief of Staff can see the deck, the numbers and the CRM together and act, with the founder approving each step.
launch_story.attribution: Baltej Singh, founder, on Product Hunt

fit: are an early-stage founder running fundraising, finance and operations yourself
want an AI assistant that sees your real numbers rather than a blank chat window
want to approve every email or action the AI drafts
not_fit: already have a mature stack you are happy with: Nautis works best when it replaces those tools
need a dedicated accounting system: Nautis tracks invoices and expenses but is not sold as accounting software
want a free plan: there is a 14-day trial, then paid plans only

pricing.intro: Nautis has three paid plans and a 14-day trial with no card. Prices are Nautis's, in US dollars; annual billing gives two months free, and the site mentions purchasing-power-parity pricing for some countries.

plans.name: Launch
plans.detail: For a solo founder: 5 team members, 500 contacts, 5 data rooms, 5 business plans

plans.name: Voyage
plans.detail: For a mid-size startup: 10 team members, 1,000 contacts, 10 data rooms

plans.name: Fleet
plans.detail: For bigger startups: 25 team members, unlimited contacts, 25 data rooms

notes: Every new workspace gets 14 days of Launch free, with no card and no automatic charge.

pros: One shared data layer across modules, so the AI sees the whole business
Role, module and record-level permissions, according to the founder
cons: Many modules means a lot to set up and migrate into

liked: One shared context instead of isolated assistants
Turning a pitch deck into a business plan
asked: How permissions work when every module shares one AI brain (role, module and record-level filters)
How the morning briefing decides what matters (missed deadlines, low runway, pending approvals, investor follow-ups)
What it takes over on day one (inbox triage, meeting summaries, investor follow-ups)

quotes.text: The wall I hit isn't the model, it's shared state: getting one agent to actually see the deck, the cap table, and the CRM at the same time.
quotes.author: Aidan Christofferson

quotes.text: Stripe, calendar and inbox in one brief would replace my first hour of the day.
quotes.author: Clemente Lopez

quotes.text: Founder tooling usually fails by trying to replace judgment instead of protecting time.
quotes.author: Clemente Lopez

alternatives.intro: These are products Product Hunt lists as Nautis alternatives. Review scores are Product Hunt users' own.

items.name: Taskade
items.what: AI workspace for teams: projects, docs and agents
items.difference: A general team workspace; Nautis is built specifically around fundraising, finance and founder operations.

items.name: Claude
items.difference: A general assistant you bring context to; Nautis keeps the business data inside its own modules.

items.name: Matilda Workspace
items.what: All-in-one workspace with projects, docs, tables and chat
items.difference: An all-in-one team workspace without Nautis's investor CRM and finance modules.

alternatives.more: Product Hunt also lists Pre and Soloop as alternatives.

x.none: We found no posts about Nautis on X to link yet.

faq.a: An AI-native operating system for startup founders: one workspace for fundraising, finance, CRM, documents, meetings, hiring and daily operations, with an AI Chief of Staff that reads across all of it.
Launch is $49 a month, Voyage $99 and Fleet $129. Every new workspace starts with a 14-day trial of Launch with no card required, and annual billing gives two months free.

faq.q: Does the AI send emails on its own?
faq.a: No. According to Nautis, you approve every action before anything leaves your workspace.

faq.q: Can team members see everything, including finance?
faq.a: No. The founder said on Product Hunt that the data layer is shared but access is not: permissions are set by role, module and record.

faq.q: Is my data used to train AI models?
faq.a: Nautis says your data never trains models and every AI action is logged.
